title: Glutamine binding and sodium coordination reveal the transport mechanism of y⁺LAT1/CD98hc

key_results: 3.4 Å cryo-EM structure in outward-open conformation with L-glutamine bound

title: PDGF-BB and bFGF repress Kai1 in pericytes through Src–DNMT-associated promoter methylation and lysosomal trafficking

key_results: PDGF-BB and bFGF (but not VEGF-A) reduce Kai1 via dual-layer program: Src-sensitive DNMT1/3A-mediated promoter methylation and PKC/Flotillin-1-dependent lysosomal degradation; combined DNMT and lysosomal inhibition reduces tumor growth in WT but not Kai1 KO mice
comments: The dual-layer regulatory mechanism is elegant and well-supported functionally, though the relative contribution of each pathway to Kai1 loss in vivo remains quantitatively unclear.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lysosomal blockade restores Kai1 and attenuates sprouting
